visibleProblem: V6 C visually passed, but its back Yokohama skyline support displayed a 240x220 source at 306x270. That meant the selected comparator contained one raster role enlarged beyond intrinsic pixel dimensions even though the same source could carry the editorial role at a smaller scale.
rootCauseHypothesis: A small support raster should not be promoted by visual balance alone when the role can remain legible at or below intrinsic dimensions. Print-fidelity QA must check intrinsic/display ratio per image role, not only whole-page screenshots.
boundedTest: Clone only V6 Outer C into rollback-safe D; keep V5 and Inside A untouched.
Resize only back support skyline node from 306x270 to 240x220 and reposition it to preserve the asymmetric cafe/skyline pair.
Do not change image hash, Drive provenance, front composition, typography, cards, shadows, gradients, or any other raster role.
Compare actual-size back and whole outer spread before promotion.

visualQA.rationale: The smaller skyline remains clearly legible as a supporting postcard, increases scale contrast against the cafe image, and removes the only below-1x intrinsic/display ratio in the selected Outer comparator.

status.next: Continue from D/A. Remaining image-quality work should prioritize actual-size visual character and source fidelity. Generate new imagery only when a specific weak role cannot be solved by role sizing, crop, or verified existing assets and when the full generation -> Drive -> Figma lifecycle is available.
